errors.evidence: The description states the train accuracy dips to around 40% at epoch 10. In the plot, the dip for the train accuracy (blue line) occurs at epoch 11, and the value is approximately 45%, not 40%.
The description claims the train accuracy remains at 100% through epoch 30, but the data presented in the plot ends at epoch 29.

The description states the validation accuracy dips to about 40% at epoch 10. In the plot, the dip for the validation accuracy (green line) occurs at epoch 11, and the value is approximately 42%, not 40%.
The description states the final validation accuracy is reached at epoch 30, but the data in the plot only extends to epoch 29.
